slice: LinkedSet index for more than eight string/number members (packages/foundation/src/collections/linked-set.ts)
rootCause: LinkedSet (every TS Set in native images) found members by walking its links: no index at all. A bootstrap-compile proxy (Node Map/Set prototypes patched, docs/results/a1-perf-map-set-sizing-patch-v1.mjs, totals in a1-perf-map-set-sizing-v1.txt) counts 241M string/number set operations walking ~2.0B entries in total (mostly small sets, mean size ~8) and 67k object-member operations walking 409M entries (large sets).
change: Promote to a KeyIndex once more than eight string/number members exist; members without a stable hash stay on the walked path; entries doubly linked for O(1) indexed deletion. Differential test vs JS Set (6,000 mixed operations, NaN, +-0, objects, clear, clone, cursors). closure-sets ABI tests use a self-contained linear set fixture, like closure-maps.
